notes.subject: vayyetse ha'egel hazeh
notes.rationale: 'And out came this calf' — Aaron's notorious evasion: he omits his own fashioning of the calf (v.4 says he formed it with a tool); rendered literally.

notes.subject: hitpareku
notes.rationale: Hithpael 'tear off (your gold earrings)' — reflexive imperative form; 'larim brukim rausim' keeps the self-directed action.

notes.subject: lemi zahav
notes.rationale: Literally 'to whom (is there) gold?' — a possessive idiom for 'whoever has gold'; rendered 'long husat i gat gol'.

translation: Na mi tok long ol: Long husat i gat gol, larim ⟨em⟩ brukim rausim; ol i givim long mi, na mi tromoim em long paia, na dispela pikinini bulmakau i kam aut.
